subtitle: 호텔 문제 · 문장별 음성 재생
desc: 에어컨이 안 되거나 수건이 더 필요할 때

tips.en: Would it be possible to get a quieter room?
tips.ko: 더 조용한 방으로 바꿀 수 있을까요?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Excuse me. The air conditioning in my room isn't working.

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: I'm sorry about that. Let me send someone up right away.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Could I also have two extra towels, please?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: Of course. What is your room number?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: We'll bring the towels in about ten minutes.
turns.ko: 십 분 정도 후에 수건 가져다 드리겠습니다.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: And would it be possible to get a quieter room?
turns.ko: 그리고 더 조용한 방으로 바꿀 수 있을까요?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: Let me check. We have a room on the fifth floor.
turns.ko: 확인해 볼게요. 오 층에 방이 있습니다.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: That would be great. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: You're welcome. I'll take care of it.
